articles.author: Paolo Uggetti
articles.title: Indiana's Curt Cignetti says Big Ten is 'best league in football' - ESPN
articles.description: Indiana coach Curt Cignetti, armed with statistical evidence, said the Big Ten doesn't "run a hype machine" and is "the best league in football."
articles.content: CHICAGO -- Seven months removed from raising Indiana's first football national championship trophy, Hoosiers coach Curt Cignetti strutted to the lectern Thursday -- with that same trophy just to his … [+3106 chars]
